'''Dellko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who worked for the [[Tourism Council of Oluna Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the opening on the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Oluna Biqua]] of the luxury resort [[Night Imperial]], the Council assigned Dellko to transport the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to Oluna Biqua. He flew them to the city aboard the [[YT-1220]] ''[[Headliner]]'', and landed the craft in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Port Epsilon]].
